column1: # Synergy connector test accounts — consumed by tests/test-connectors.sh
# One account per line, pipe-delimited (leading/trailing spaces trimmed). Blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored. Copy this to accounts.local.tsv (gitignored) and fill in real
# creds — DO NOT commit real passwords/tokens.
#   templateId    | the account template id            (e.g. com.palm.telegram)
#   capabilityId  | the MESSAGING/IM capability id      (e.g. com.palm.telegram.im)
#   password      | credential (password, token, or session); leave empty for QR/interactive links
#   expect        | expected end state: online | challenge | any   (what counts as PASS)
